items.title: Lie and square generators for the signed random-to-top tensor kernel
items.author: Darij Grinberg
items.source_version: Official author source, last-update 2026-05-21; arXiv:1505.01201 alias (CC0 1.0)
items.difficulty_reason: The author identifies the signed random-to-top kernel on the tensor algebra of a free module over the stated commutative ring as the subalgebra generated by the original square/Lie-supercommutator module h. Joint derivation kernels, super-bracket closure and the descending basis filtration supply the original proof. No characteristic-zero assumption is added; unsigned and positive-characteristic analogues remain complete context, not extra counts.
